analyst_view.overall: Le Mans (13th, 11 pts) host Lille (3rd, 21 pts) on Saturday evening. Le Mans drew 2-2 at Marseille last time, while Davide Ancelotti's Lille lost 1-0 at home to Lyon and now play Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Wednesday, three days before this game, with only one point from four European games so far. Lille are without striker Ayase Ueda (foot), Hamza Igamane (knee, back in December) and Tiago Santos (knee, out for the season), with Nianzou doubtful; Le Mans are without Sidibe and Bourabaa, and Colas (a scorer at Marseille) and Yohou are doubtful. The numbers list no missing players for either side, so Ueda's absence and any rotation after Bayern are not in them; that points to a slightly quieter Lille attack. No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, 1.5 of them for Lille, and they list no missing players. Lille will likely be without Ueda, their joint-top scorer, and may rotate after Bayern on Wednesday; they have already scored only 6 in their last six. I lean a little lower, 2.6 to about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners, with Le Mans expected to win slightly more at home. Rotation could change Lille's shape, but nothing I read points to more or fewer wide attacks, so I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already trimmed because Lille's recent opponents have drawn few cards and Le Mans have been booked often (17 in six). There is no rivalry and no referee named yet, so I stay at about 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.1 shots and already take some off for Lille's quieter recent run (66 shots in six). A Champions League game against Bayern three days earlier makes some rotation likely, and Ueda is out, so I lean slightly lower, 23.1 to about 22.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target, 4.4 of them for Lille. Without Ueda and with tired legs or rotation after Bayern, Lille's finishing should be a little blunter than the numbers assume, so I lean slightly lower, 8.2 to about 7.9.
